# concubro

> concubro is a small static site for essays and odd things. Human-facing pages are HTML, and machine-friendly plain-text versions of the essays are linked directly below.

The canonical HTML contains each complete essay. Plain-text editions are also available for readers that prefer them.

## Essays

- [Everyone's a Builder, Nobody Can Read](https://concubro.com/everyones-a-builder-nobody-can-read.txt): A paper about the rise of epistemic misinformation in frontier AI spaces.
- [When the Trolls Won](https://concubro.com/when-the-trolls-won.txt): An essay on how irony-poisoned internet culture deforms AI discourse, authority, and sincere inquiry.
- [The line moves...](https://concubro.com/the-line-moves.txt): An essay about AI legitimacy, local power, and who gets to own the tools.
